texts.preamble: M/S.Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort ... vs The Commercial Tax Officer (Luxuty Tax) on 16 June, 2016 Author: Antony Dominic Bench: Antony Dominic, Dama Seshadri Naidu In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Honourable Mr.Justice Antony Dominic & The Honourable Mr. Justice Dama Seshadri Naidu Friday, The 16Th Day Of December 2016/25Th Agrahayana, 1938 RP.No. 969 of 2016 In Op (Tax)33/2016 -------------------------------------- Against The Judgment In Op (Tax) 33/2016 of High Court Of Kerala Dated 16-06-2016 Review Petitioner/Petitioner: ----------------------------- M/S.Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt.Ltd. Olassery P.O., Kodumbu, Palakkad District, Represented By Its Managing Director, Shri. K.V.Ramesh. By Advs.Sri.T.M.Sreedharan (Sr.) Sri.V.P.Narayanan Smt.Divya Ravindran Respondents/Respondents : ------------------------- 1. The Commercial Tax Officer (Luxuty Tax) Department Of Commercial Taxes, Office Of The Deputy Commissioner, Palakkad-678 001. 2. The Deputy Commissioner (Appeals)-I Kottayam (Located At Ernakulam), Commercial Taxes, Ernakulam. 3. The Assistant Secretary Kerala Agricultural Income Tax And Sales Tax Appellate M/S.Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort ... vs The Commercial Tax Officer (Luxuty Tax) on 16 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192106250/ 1 Tribunal, Additional Bench, Near Saradha Shankara Kalyana Mandapam, Nurani P.O., Palakkad-678 001. R By Government Pleader Sri.C.K.Govindan This Review Petition Having Been Finally Heard On 16-12-2016, Along With Rp. 980/2016, Rp. 981/2016, The Court On The Same Day Passed The Following: RP.No. 969 of 2016 Appendix Koru, Munich, Germany, Who Underwent Treatment For 30 Days, From 16.10.2008 To 14.11.208, Covered By Regn.No.626/Sa/Pk/08 In Room No.302. Annexure E: True Copy Of Case Sheets Relating To Ms.Ivana Fiva, Rome, -As Per Regn.No.694/Sa/Pk/0/09, Who Underwent Treatment For 22 Days From 5.1.2009 To 16.1.2009 And Occupied Room No.14. Annexure F: True Copy Of Case Sheets Relating To Mrs.Gerhild Albes, Gemany, As Per Regn. No.1613/Rj/S&S/1/11 Dated 5.1.2011 For A Period Of 20 Days From 4.1.2011 To 24.1.2011 In Room No.102. Annexure G: True Copy Of Case Sheets Relating To Shri.Volker, Dorf Str., Germany, Who Underwent Treatment For 17 Days From 10.5.2010 To 26.5.2010 And Covered By Regn.No.1315/2010 Dated 10.5.2010 And Occupied Room No.303. Annexure H: True Copy Of Certificate Dated 24.5.2008 Issued By The Kodumbu Grama Panchayat For Running Ayurvedic Hospital. Annexure H(a): True Copy Of Certificate Dated 24.4.2009 Issued By The Kodumbu Grama Panchayat For Running Canteen.
